channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: Bihar BJP MLA criticises own government for distributing ₹10,000 crore to JEEVIKA didis
item.description: He further argued that how the development will take place if there is a burden of debt, and challenges will arise in mobilising resources for schemes in the future also.

item.title: CM Fadnavis and DCM Shinde visit drought-prone regions in Maharashtra
item.description: The tour of CM and DCM comes after Devendra Fadnavis announced the formation of a subcommittee to handle the drought issue under the chairmanship of Revenue Minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule

item.title: U.P. CM Yogi launches Bharat Taxi and Mukhyamantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana
item.description: Now, upon registration, taxi drivers will become part of Bharat Taxi on zero commission and will receive social security of ₹5 lakh, said Yogi Adityanath

item.title: Madhya Pradesh traders, retailers observe ‘No UPI Day’, seek rollback of MDR charges
item.description: In cities like Bhopal and Indore, QR code stickers and payment confirmation soundboxes on several shops were seen covered with a black cloth, with the traders requesting customers to pay in cash

item.title: West Bengal CM asks Ministers to concentrate on work rather than being hyperactive on the street
item.description: Two Ministers of the Suvendu Adhikari cabinet- Minister for Municipal Affairs Agnimitra Paul and Health Minister Sharadwat Mukherjee have been seen being active visiting streets and hospitals respectively

item.title: Bihar Cabinet gives nod for setting up two universities
item.description: Mata Sita Women’s University will be set up at Patna & Rashtrakavi Ramdhari Singh ‘Dinkar’ University at Begusarai; a total of 24 decisions were taken at the cabinet meeting chaired by CM Samrat Choudhary

item.title: BSP president Mayawati appoints younger nephew Ishan Anand as new national convener
item.description: The decision was announced at a meeting of the BSP’s national executive held at the party headquarters in Lucknow, chaired by Mayawati

item.title: Elephant calf swept away in Teesta rescued by fishermen, reunited with mother
item.description: The calf was crossing the river near the barrage when the strong currents swept it away from the herd. Its rescue was captured on camera

item.title: Man kills wife and priests in ritual dispute in Azamgarh, later dies in police encounter
item.description: After shooting two priests and his wife, the accused Arvind Singh locked himself along with three children inside the house, creating hostage situation

item.title: Prepared for another fight, says Hooda, seeks support from voters in his Assembly constituency
item.description: Former Haryana Chief Minister and Leader of the Opposition makes it clear that he is not ready to hang up his political boots

item.title: Minister in CEC-EC selection panel fails ‘perception test’, says Justice Datta in split verdict
item.description: Justice Datta said the Minister “cannot be expected to defy the Prime Minister”; he said the Prime Minister and his Cabinet Minister shared a “collective responsibility” and inclusion of a Minister “fails to provide an independent countenance”

item.title: Omar, Mehbooba flag differences within ECI, seek course correction
item.description: The Election Commission and Government should consider the issue, particularly if eligible voters were prevented from exercising their franchise, Omar Abdullah said

item.title: Priyanka Gandhi meets flood victims, workers in Nilambur
item.description: The MP meets relatives of a flood victim, rural and autorickshaw workers and assures them that she will take up their concerns with the authorities concerned

item.title: Eight Meghalaya UDP MLAs join BJP
Rain batters Srikakulam for second day
item.description: Vajrapukotturu village in Srikakulam district recorded highest rainfall of 88.25 mm; Orange alert has been issued for Visakhapatnam, Srikakulam, Anakapalli, and Alluri Sitarama Raju districts; all educational institutions in these districts to remain closed owing to the heavy rain forecast

item.title: Several banks offer rebate on interest rates for green buildings, says expert
item.description: Panellists at sustainability summit call for State government incentivising green buildings

item.title: CPCL looking to be a part of the renewable energy growth journey: H. Shankar
item.description: ‘CBG (compressed bio-gas) is fuel that can be a good form of energy we can invest in. With SAF (sustainable aviation fuel), we can be a part of sustainability in aviation fuel,’ the Managing Director of the Navratna company says

item.title: The Hindu Sustainability Summit: ‘Treat waste water as an economic resource’
item.description: Oil majors seek to replace fresh water intake with treated water; dismissing the myth that desalination is expensive, expert calls for leveraging Chennai’s coastline; IIT-M prof says technology can help monitor groundwater situation

item.title: Sustainability must be backed by measurable outcomes, practical action: Tamil Nadu Minister V.K. Rajeev
item.description: The Minister was speaking at the inauguration of The Hindu Sustainability Summit 2026 in Chennai on Wednesday

item.title: Refinery sector must balance energy security with net-zero push: industry experts at The Hindu Sustainability Summit
item.description: At a discussion about ‘Fossils to Net Zero: Transforming India’s Refinery and Energy Landscape’, the panel touched on renewable energy, geopolitical disruptions on crude supplies, and the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme

item.title: UG-NEET: Third round counselling from September 24
Communication between CEC, ECs shows functioning democracy: BJP
item.description: The party rejects Opposition’s charge against SIR process, says Supreme Court had upheld its legal validity multiple times

item.title: Malkajgiri police seize 730 kg suspected adulterated ginger-garlic paste, 500 kg paneer in food safety raids
Over 70 tree species among 1,128 marked for felling for Hebbal tunnel project
item.description: The species list includes Indian Kino, Big-leaf Mahogany, Beleric Myrobalan, Indian Jujube, Maple-leafed Bayur Tree, Paper Mulberry and Yellow Tabebuia, among others.

item.title: Mystery shrouds nursing student’s death in Bhadradri Kothagudem district
CM congratulates badminton team after bronze medal win
SIR is illegal and needs to be reversed: former CEC Quraishi
item.description: Delimitation and SIR are intertwined and tailored to favour BJP, say Opposition leaders at The Hindu event; government has not yet prorogued the Monsoon Session as it plans to bring the Bills around October 11, says Jairam Ramesh

item.title: Ladakh bodies hold protests ahead of Sep. 24 violence anniversary; Ladakh L-G withdraws cases against 20 locals
item.description: Sonam Wangchuk led a symbolic padyatra in Leh to mark the first anniversary of the September 24, 2025, violence during protests seeking statehood and Sixth Schedule safeguards for Ladakh

item.title: Wellness hub for gig workers opened in Kochi
item.description: The centre to provide safe rest facilities and basic welfare amenities to gig workers in food delivery, e-commerce and ride-hailing sectors

item.title: Supreme Court stays High Court order to recover ₹5 lakh from Noida DM in NSA detention case
item.description: Appearing for Medha Roopam, senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi submitted that such decisions went through a multi-tiered process and his client cannot be singled out for penalty

item.title: In meeting with Rubio, Jaishankar raises India’s concerns about sanctions Act
item.description: The External Affairs Minister and the Secretary of State are also understood to be preparing for high-level meetings between U.S. President Donald Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi later this year

item.title: NLCIL signs MoU with C-DAC to explore opportunities in green digital infrastructure
Notice issued to candidate for applying for guest lecturer post under two names
Tatipamula erupts in celebration as Uttam makes an emotional homecoming
item.description: Pledges ₹7 Crore for Educational Institutions- ₹5 crore for High School, ₹2 crore for primary school buildings and Lasting development

item.title: BJP leader asks Karnataka to learn from Tamil Nadu on protecting interests of farmers
item.description: Accusing the Karnataka government and Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar of failing to protect the interests of the State with respect to the Cauvery, Deputy Leader of the Opposition Arvind Bellad remarked that the State should learn from Tamil Nadu on protecting its share of water as well as its farmers during distress

item.title: Hoax bomb threat at new bus terminus in Vellore town
item.description: The new terminus facilitates the operation of more than 500 buses

item.title: Vijayendra seeks ₹5 lakh farm loan waiver for drought-hit farmers in Karnataka
item.description: BJP State president B.Y. Vijayendra demanded a waiver of crop loans of up to ₹5 lakh for farmers affected by the severe drought in Karnataka

item.title: Front-of-pack nutrition labelling to be rolled out in single phase, FSSAI tells Supreme Court
item.description: The regulator sought a four-month period for issuing and finalising the draft regulations under the Food Safety and Standards Act

item.title: Man dies in wall collapse at Ranipet
Three held for death of senior citizen in Tirupattur
item.description: Three persons were arrested and lodged at Central Prison in Vellore

item.title: Kudumbashree’s Janakeeya hotels shrink in Kozhikode as subsidies dry up
item.description: Introduced under the State government’s Hunger-free Keralam initiative in 2020 to provide a traditional meal at ₹20, Janakeeya hotels in Kozhikode have declined from 102 to 72, with six outlets shutting down during the current financial year

item.title: Work on road overbridge on Krishnagiri – Ranipet main road in Vellore town nears completion
item.description: The ROB will replace the existing manned railway level crossing (LC 128) on Krishnagiri - Ranipet Main Road

item.title: DKS writes to PM seeking immediate interim drought relief
MLA demands hike of ₹10 a litre in milk procurement price to help drought-hit farmers in Karnataka
Clamour against Collegium feeble attempt to hide government ‘dereliction and failure’, says Justice Datta
item.description: Justice Sharma differs, says Solicitor General’s remarks were not criticism of Collegium system

item.title: Social security, welfare fund board pension distribution from September 24
One Indian killed in attack on ship off Oman; Centre condemns attack
item.description: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said that Suraj Yadav from Uttar Pradesh succumbed to head injuries after the attack on the vessel MV Cape Dao; Mr. Sonowal also said there were 20 Indian seafarers on board, and all 19 surviving crew members have been safely evacuated by the Royal Navy of Oman

item.title: SIT chargesheet in Ram Temple donation theft case names eight accused
item.description: As soon as local advocates at the District Court learnt about the chargesheet being filed they launched a protest by halting work and going on strike

item.title: Asian Games 2026 highlights | India concludes Day 4 with overall one gold, five silver and six bronze medals
item.description: India’s men’s and women’s skeet teams and men’s badminton team clinch bronze in Nagoya

item.title: Germany ready to sign ‘forward leaning’ deal with India for submarines: German Ambassador to India
item.description: Mr. Wieck pointed out that both Germany and India have increased investments in their military capabilities because of the worldwide situation that he described as an ‘unfriendly geostrategic environment’

item.title: CM, Deputy CM review power
item.description: CM, Dy CM question officials over the failure to achieve full-scale power generation at the Yadadri Thermal Power Plant.

item.title: India-EU FTA to be signed on December 16
item.description: The signing will be part of Prime Minister Modi’s upcoming trips in December to Canada, the U.S., and Belgium, where three separate FTAs are currently either being negotiated or in the process of approval

item.title: P.P. Umer Musliyar Koyyode chosen Samastha general secretary
item.description: Sunni scholars’ forum forms eight-member consultative committee to deliberate on important matters

item.title: IIT Bombay forms panel to probe student’s death
item.description: The Mumbai Police have transferred the probe into Sahil Wakode’s death to the Crime Branch; Prof. Suryanarayana Doolla, who has been named in the case, has been sent on leave

item.title: MoD inks ₹811 crore contract for 160 SAT-SAAW glide bombs for IAF
item.description: According to the Ministry of Defence, Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh was present when the contract was signed in New Delhi under the Buy (Indian-Indigenously Designed, Developed and Manufactured) category

item.title: BJP announces new State in-charges; Anil Baluni elevated as coordinator of party’s communications
item.description: BJP national president Nitin Nabin has assigned Lok Sabha MP Anil Baluni with overall coordinator for communications including social media, TV and print media; party vice-president Ram Madhav to oversee poll-bound Uttarakhand

item.title: Keralam CM bats again for zoo relocation
item.description: Protest organised by Kerala NGO Union at zoo and museum complex on Wednesday evening

item.title: EAGLE Force seizes ₹25 lakh assets linked to drug trafficking

item.description: The centre is the first of its kind in the country and a pilot project of the Bihar State Legal Services Authority (BLSA); a transgender helpline will also be launched on the day
